title: Kinetic type
line: Big tight type is the picture: words snap in from the side with a capped overshoot and a motion streak, rows are masked windows, one accent colour on near-black.
bestFor: a number or claim that must land
any beat with no physical subject

beats.visual: CUT / BY / WORDS. snap in from the right one row after another, WORDS. in lime.
The three rows rest, crisp; the kicker and the footer stay fixed.

beats.say: Then the next idea pushes it out.
beats.visual: Each row hands over: the old word slides left out of its window as SHIP / EVERY / WEEK. pushes in from the right.
SHIP / EVERY / WEEK. rest, WEEK. in lime; hold to the end.
